articles.title: Army Commanders' Conference begins, Rajnath Singh to release Land Warfare Doctrine
articles.summary: The three-day Army Commanders' Conference began in New Delhi, where Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is set to release the 'Land Warfare Doctrine'. This pivotal vision document will outline India's strategic approach to land warfare, guiding future operations and modernization. The conference serves as a critical forum for high-level discussions on national security and defence preparedness, offering crucial insights for SSB aspirants into India's military strategy and future direction.

articles.title: CBSE LOC 2027 deadline today: Check late fee, dates and key guidelines
articles.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is closing its List of Candidates (LOC) submission website today, October 21st. All affiliated schools are urged to promptly complete the LOC submission process for students appearing in the 2026-27 board examinations. This critical deadline ensures timely administrative preparations for future CBSE academic sessions across the nation.

articles.title: Oshkosh guide to Brewers World Series watch spots
articles.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers are set to face the Tampa Bay Rays in the World Series championship. This highly anticipated baseball matchup marks the Brewers' pursuit of their first-ever franchise title. The series sets the stage for a significant showdown, with Milwaukee aiming for championship glory against the formidable Tampa Bay Rays.

articles.title: NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover just shattered the all-time off-world driving record
articles.summary: NASA's Perseverance rover has set a new driving record on another world, traveling farther across an extraterrestrial surface than any vehicle before it. On October 11, the rover's odometer marked this significant milestone. This achievement highlights advancements in robotic space exploration and our capability to navigate and study distant planetary environments.

articles.title: Nifty India Defence index slips 3%; Unimech, Axiscades, Dynamatic tank 7%
articles.summary: Several prominent Indian defence and aerospace sector companies, including Apollo Micro, MTAR Tech, and Paras Defence, experienced a notable downturn in their stock prices. These key players, involved in military technology and manufacturing, saw their shares decline by 4 to 6 percent. This broad dip indicates a significant bearish trend affecting multiple listed entities within the defence industry segment.
